## Context

- `src/schema.rs` converts `serde_json::Value` to Python via `serde_json::to_string` + Python `json.loads`.
- Used for `json=` kwargs and JWT `claims=` on every JSON-body / authed route (`src/dispatch.rs`).

## Problem

Double serialization and parsing add CPU, heap allocations, and GIL time on JSON-heavy routes.

## Proposed change

Implement direct recursive conversion `serde_json::Value → PyObject` (PyDict, PyList, PyString, PyFloat, PyLong, PyBool, None) via PyO3, replacing the string roundtrip in `json_to_py`.

## Files

- `src/schema.rs`, `src/dispatch.rs`
- tests for nested object/array/string/number/bool/null in `json` body and `claims`

## Acceptance criteria

- Semantics of `json=` and `claims=` kwargs match current behaviour.
- No intermediate JSON string in the hot path.
- Tests cover nested structures and edge types.

## Expected low-level impact

Lower CPU and allocations on JSON and JWT routes; less time under the GIL.
